AdAnimatedHorizontalContentItem.Descript:
Here you can set preferred advertising shown settings. 
Ad showing only in application window – notifications or other popups not allowed. Application won't collect or share your data.
CompleteAnimatedHorizontalContentItem.De:
If you have some questions about app you can visit offline help (cdpiui://help) or contact community support (you can find links on [About] page)

If you found some bug tell about it developer – we can make application better together!

Click [Close] to close this wizard. Enjoy!

MigrationAnimatedHorizontalContentItemDe: CDPIUI will install the components required by your selected presets and then import the verified data package.
MigrationPreparingMessage: Checking the transfer package and protecting a local copy. No settings are being changed yet.
MigrationComponentsReadyMessage: The package is verified. Continue through the license step to prepare the required components.
MigrationLoadingStoreMessage: Loading the component catalog and checking compatibility.
MigrationComponentLicenseMessage: Review the licenses of the components needed by the transferred presets.
MigrationComponentLicenseDeclined: The transfer is paused until the required component licenses are accepted.
MigrationDownloadingMessage: Downloading and installing the components required by the transferred presets.
MigrationImportMessage: Creating the separate migrated preset collection and applying compatible settings.
MigrationCompletedMessage: Your selected GoodbyeDPI-UI data is ready in CDPIUI.
MigrationImportIncompleteMessage: This information could not be transferred from GoodbyeDPI-UI.
MigrationImportWarningsSummary: Items that could not be transferred: {0}. The remaining information is available in CDPIUI.
MigrationAlreadyCompleted: This exact transfer package was already imported. No duplicate presets were created.
MigrationStoreLoadFailed: The component catalog could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
MigrationComponentMissingFromStore: A component required by the transferred presets is absent from the selected Store source.
MigrationComponentUnsupported: A required component is not compatible with this version of CDPIUI.
MigrationComponentInstallFailed: A required component could not be installed.
MigrationComponentInstallStopped: Component installation stopped before all required components were ready.
MigrationImportSummary: Imported presets: {0}; TXT/BIN resources: {1}; compatible settings: {2}. Presets marked for review: {3}.
MigrationNoComponentsRequired: No additional components are required for the selected data.
ProxyAnimatedHorizontalContentItem.Descr:
Store helps you install items from GitHub (Zapret, TG WS Proxy, for example). If GitHub isn't available for you internal proxy may help.
If you don't have any problems with GitHub – skip this step.
MigrationError_MIGRATION_ARCHIVE_NOT_FOU: The transfer archive was not found.
MigrationError_MIGRATION_ARCHIVE_INVALID: The transfer archive is damaged or has an unsupported format.
MigrationError_MIGRATION_ARCHIVE_ACCESS_: Access to the transfer archive was denied.
MigrationError_MIGRATION_PREPARATION_FAI: Could not prepare the data for the transfer.
